product.name: NextIDE
product.description: NextIDE is a minimal, platform-neutral editor kernel with a CLI and a headless desktop shell bootstrap (Rust workspace).
product.notes: product.version must equal the [workspace.package] version declared in the root Cargo.toml; build.ps1 enforces the match by read-only text parsing of Cargo.toml (no cargo invocation, no dependencies) and fails before building or staging on any mismatch.

target.notes: The project targets Windows x86_64. build.ps1 enforces that this target block matches the pinned packaging target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc (os windows, architecture x86_64, triple x86_64-pc-windows-msvc) and fails before building or staging on any mismatch, so a stale or cross-arch manifest can never stage an artifact set for the wrong platform. The release build itself runs with the host stable Rust toolchain (cargo build --release).

artifacts.description: NextIDE command-line interface (usage/help and the editor-kernel smoke flow)
NextIDE headless desktop shell bootstrap (command registry, Git status/diff model layer)

verification.notes: Every artifact is checked before staging (source must exist) and after staging (staged copy must exist and match the release binary by size and SHA-256). An artifact may additionally pin an expected_sha256; when present, the staged hash must equal it exactly.
